meta_description:
383 likes, 1,617 comments - simrun.chopra on October 1, 2026: "Tell me your struggles with hair. Give me as many details as possible and ill reply to all. 

Example 
Dont say ... i have hair loss 
Explain... where do you see the hair (in the shower, on thr floor) 
Or what type of hair loss 
- are you shedding overall 
- Is youre centre parting getting wider 
- are you just losing from the crown area etc 

Each of these will have different solutions. 

So whatever the hair issue please give me as many details as you can".
